original_message: Kal subah meri bike MH12TZ6832 Andheri mein fisal gayi; tank aur handle dent ho gaye. Haath se khoon nikal raha tha, clinic ne cut saaf karke stitches laga diye. Claim shuru karne mein madad karo. Policy MOT-7042186; repair estimate 18k hai.

original_message: My hatchback MH-02-LM-9074 hit a deep rut in Vikhroli; its front wheel folded inward. Wheel lock ho gaya, gaadi hil nahi rahi, so I called a tow truck. Nobody was hurt. The suspention needs checking too; please start a claim.

I confirm this is the collision I am reporting. The cart frame is bent and his family called about treatment. In April my van MH-12-GH-8061 scraped a bollard near home; on 26 August at Indore it rolled into a roadside tea stall and bent the steel shutter and counter. The owner sent photos and wants the repair handled, and I am reporting the August damage to the stall. My garage has not given a final estimate yet, but the owner says the shutter and counter work is approx 45000. I can forward the receipt tmrw, but the shop is open and asked me to report the damage today. The shutter has a second crease that may affect the repair cost, and the mechanic also wants to inspect the van's front corner. Please advise whether I should send the owner's quote or wait for an inspection; the old scrape was minor and is a separate incident. Policy MOT-6104982.
note: The sender explicitly asks to file for the August stall damage; the April scrape is another distinct event.
